podcast.body: Guitar god Jimi Hendrix's cover of Bob Dylan's "elliptically poetic" song, released three years after Dylan's original. This iconic rendition became the only top 40 hit of Hendrix's lifetime. "guitar god Jimmy Hendrix scored the only top 40 hit of his lifetime with his cover of Dylan's elliptically poetic all along the watchtower."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: Jimi Hendrix's "All Along the Watchtower" was deliberately not featured in the TV series *Mad Men*. The show's musical choices sought to depict the authentic popular culture of the 1960s, steering clear of cliched protest music common in other portrayals. "no uh all along the watch tower by Jimmy Hendrix."
